email.body1:
Austin, saw IMPLAN launch the Forward Linkages Suite and AI Summary, the first downstream impact tool, with the 2026 Summit on the calendar.

New capabilities like that usually open more in-market accounts than the team can touch, and in academic territories good-fit institutions go cold before a rep reaches them. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for IMPLAN off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Austin, quick follow-up for IMPLAN's academic territory.

With new products in market, pipeline expectations rise faster than you can add reps. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit target, so the coverage gap surfaces late and the quarter turns into catch-up.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your academic region needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Austin, last bit of proof for IMPLAN.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your reply rate likely compares to other B2B software teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Austin, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling academic pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters, and covering a full academic region keeps a sales manager busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your academic motion? I'll tailor it to IMPLAN either way.
